mapper.sql:
FROM saving_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id
g.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (g.group_name LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR g.description LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!')
AND r.region_name = #{regionName} AND sg.status = #{status}
mapper.select:
SELECT sg.saving_group_id, g.group_id, g.group_name, g.description, r.region_name, g.max_members, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gm.member_id) FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = g.group_id AND gm.membership_status = 'APPROVED') AS member_count, sg.dues_amount, sg.dues_day, sg.status, g.created_at
ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, sg.saving_group_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT sg.saving_group_id, g.group_id, g.group_name, g.description, r.region_name, sg.saving_group_type, g.max_members, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gm.member_id) FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = g.group_id AND gm.membership_status = 'APPROVED') AS member_count, sg.dues_amount, sg.dues_day, sg.start_date, sg.end_date, sg.status, COALESCE(( SELECT rh.action = 'RESTRICT' FROM restriction_history rh WHERE rh.saving_group_id = sg.saving_group_id ORDER BY rh.restriction_history_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), FALSE) AS admin_restricted, sg.group_image, g.member_id AS owner_member_id, m.nickname AS owner_nickname, g.created_at FROM saving_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.member_id = g.member_id WHERE sg.saving_group_id = #{savingGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT sg.saving_group_id, sg.group_id, sg.status FROM saving_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id WHERE sg.saving_group_id = #{savingGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT action FROM restriction_history WHERE saving_group_id = #{savingGroupId} ORDER BY restriction_history_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restriction_history ( member_id, saving_group_id, action, restriction_type, reason, restricted_until ) VALUES ( NULL, #{savingGroupId}, #{action}, NULL, #{reason}, NULL )
